title: SPIRE 註冊：選擇器交集與身分誤授風險
titleEn: SPIRE registration: selector intersections and unintended identity grants
subcategoryTitle: 工作負載身分與聯邦信任驗證

summaryEn: Create 12 synthetic process records containing node, namespace, service account and image digest. Hold the parent identity fixed, then draw the intersection of three workload-selector sets.

References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.textEn: SPIRE maps attested workload properties to registered identities. This case analyzes multiple selectors and registration revisions rather than repeating a generic interactive-login truth table.

knowledge.textEn: Required selectors must hold together; observing a process twice does not create another eligible process. Compare explicit set intersections with registration entries while separating node attestation from workload attestation.
